source_dcp: Nikon Z 5 2 RawLab LR Adobe Standard Baseline.dcp
sampling_domain: HSV(线性 ProPhoto, 与 DNG SDK HSM 应用域一致) → 线性 sRGB → gamma sRGB → OKLCh (core.oklab)

point_semantics.grid: [i_hue, j_sat, k_val] 源表网格索引 (布局 ((v*H)+h)*S+s)
point_semantics.h/c/l: 查表前像素的 OKLCh 色相(度)/色度/亮度
point_semantics.dh: 查表后色相增量 (度, 折回 ±180)
point_semantics.c_gain: 查表后色度增益 (C_out/C_in; C_in≈0 时恒 1)
point_semantics.l_gain: 查表后亮度增益 (L_out/L_in; L_in≈0 时恒 1)
